  FROM code.files f
  WHERE f.is_test = FALSE
    AND f.directory NOT LIKE '%tests/%'
),
connector_classes AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id,
         s.qualname,
         s.file_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN production_files p ON s.file_id = p.file_id
  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
    AND s.enclosing_class_symbol_id IS NULL
),
connector_subclasses AS (
  SELECT c.class_symbol_id,
         c.qualname,
         c.file_id
  FROM connector_classes c
  JOIN code.class_ancestry anc ON c.class_symbol_id = anc.class_symbol_id
  WHERE anc.ancestor_symbol_id IN (
    SELECT s.symbol_id
    FROM code.symbols s
    WHERE s.name = 'SQLDatabase'
      AND s.file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM production_files)
  )
),
connector_methods AS (

         s.name AS method_name
  FROM code.symbol_profile cm
  JOIN code.symbols s ON cm.symbol_id = s.symbol_id
  WHERE cm.class_symbol_id IN (SELECT class_symbol_id FROM connector_subclasses)
    AND s.kind IN ('function', 'method')
    AND s.is_public = TRUE
    AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
    AND cm.enclosing_class_symbol_id = cm.class_symbol_id
),
connector_own_methods AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT class_symbol_id, method_name
  FROM connector_methods
  WHERE (class_symbol_id, method_name) NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT s2.symbol_id, s2.name
    FROM code.symbols s2
    WHERE s2.file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM production_files)
      AND s2.name NOT LIKE '_%'
      AND s2.kind IN ('function', 'method')
      AND s2.is_public = TRUE

)

request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
explanation: The query filters production files by excluding those where the package or module name contains 'tests', since the file_name and directory columns are not available. It then identifies connector classes that subclass SQLDatabase, gathers their public non-dunder methods, and removes any that also appear as public methods elsewhere in production code.
sql:
WITH production_files AS (
  SELECT f.file_id
  FROM code.files f
  WHERE f.is_test = FALSE
    AND (f.package LIKE '%tests%' OR f.module LIKE '%tests%')
),
connector_classes AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id,
         s.qualname,
         s.file_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  JOIN production_files p ON s.file_id = p.file_id
  WHERE s.kind = 'class'
    AND s.enclosing_class_symbol_id IS NULL
),
connector_subclasses AS (
  SELECT c.class_symbol_id,
         c.qualname,
         c.file_id
  FROM connector_classes c
  JOIN code.class_ancestry anc ON c.class_symbol_id = anc.class_symbol_id
  WHERE anc.ancestor_symbol_id IN (
    SELECT s.symbol_id
    FROM code.symbols s
    WHERE s.name = 'SQLDatabase'
      AND s.file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM production_files)
  )
),
connector_methods AS (
  SELECT cm.class_symbol_id,
         s.name AS method_name
  FROM code.symbol_profile cm
  JOIN code.symbols s ON cm.symbol_id = s.symbol_id
  WHERE cm.class_symbol_id IN (SELECT class_symbol_id FROM connector_subclasses)
    AND s.kind IN ('function', 'method')
    AND s.is_public = TRUE
    AND s.name NOT LIKE '_%'
    AND cm.enclosing_class_symbol_id = cm.class_symbol_id
),
connector_own_methods AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT class_symbol_id, method_name
  FROM connector_methods
  WHERE (class_symbol_id, method_name) NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT s2.symbol_id, s2.name
    FROM code.symbols s2
    WHERE s2.is_public = TRUE
      AND s2.name NOT LIKE '_%'
      AND s2.kind IN ('function', 'method')
  )
)
SELECT class_symbol_id, method_name
FROM connector_own_methods
ORDER BY class_symbol_id, method_name;
